newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon gets $63 mln European loan.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon gets $63 mln European loan.

text.p: The European Investment Bank (EIB) granted Lebanon a $63 million soft loan for enviromental projects, the government's Council for Development and Reconstruction (CDR) said in a statement on Thursday.
A CDR source added the loan was for 16 years and carried interest of 3.5 percent per annum with a five-year grace period.
"The fund covers projects to be carried out by the Ministry of Electricity and Water Resources aiming at reducing water pollution from Lebanese coastal cities," the CDR statement said.
EIB loans for infrastructure reconstruction since 1993 totalled 300 million ECU, it added.
